grade.message: We were caught in the Rotterdam disruption last week. Our Deutsche Bahn train home (DBD09A), was cancelled, we rebooked and paid for an extra hotel night with you, then the rebooked train was cancelled too, so in the end we went home by ferry. I claimed the hotel night and one day of food with receipts. After a lot of chasing DB customer care replied today that the refund will be processed. Can you make sure it actually gets paid, and where is the refund for the train itself? We had a claim with DB in September that went fine. sofie.jansen@example.com, card 6109.
